artifact: CAT quant skill naming — corpus-side canonical names, for RAG before the :Skill nodes are created
why: RAG is creating ~7 CAT quant :Skill nodes and asked for better canonical names from the corpus side BEFORE creation. taxonomy.skill_key in data/exports/vmsg_questions_v1.jsonl is the join key, so a name that does not match a skill_key joins zero questions.
headline: 'Ratio and Proportion' does NOT exist in this corpus. The canonical label is 'Ratio, Proportion and Variation' (140 rows / 135 playable) and it already has an entry with aliases in taxonomy_v1_1. Creating 'Ratio and Proportion' would join nothing.
naming_trap: Do not name-match on substrings: 'Mensuration' CONTAINS 'ratio', so a LIKE '%ratio%' match pulls 422 Geometry and Mensuration rows into Ratio/Proportion. Match on the exact skill_key, or use word boundaries. This bit us while preparing this file.

do_not_normalise.why: These look like house-style violations (lowercase / missing space) but they are the LIVE GRAPH's own :Skill names — provenance neo4j_skill_nonstub, graph_backed true. Rewriting skill_key to Title Case would break the BKT join. If the presentation is wrong, fix display_label, which is owner-changeable; skill_key must keep matching the graph.
